basic_details.job_title: Mumbai Suburban District Revenue Servant (Kotwal) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 13 Posts

application_fee.details: The examination fee must be paid via Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favor of "तहसिलदार अंधेरी तथा सदस्य सचिव, कोतवाल निवड समिती" payable at Mumbai. Cash and cheques are not accepted. The application fee is non-refundable.

age_limit.details: Candidates must be between 18 years and 40 years of age as of the last date of application submission (24 October 2026).

qualification.details: The applicant must be a local resident of the respective taluka for whose Kotwal post they are applying. | The candidate must be capable of discharging Kotwal duties and must possess good moral character and physical fitness.

selection_process: Objective Test General Knowledge & Intellectual Aptitude, Marathi, Mathematics, Science, History & Civics, Geography, and Mumbai Suburban District-related questions 50 Multiple Choice Questions 100 1 Hour (11:00 AM to 12:00 PM)
The selection process consists of a written examination carrying 100 marks
followed by document verification and medical/character verification.
The written test contains objective-type multiple-choice questions in Marathi medium. There is no mention of negative marking in the official notification.
how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed application form from the office of Tehsildar Andheri, Tehsildar Borivali, or Tehsildar Kurla by paying Rs. 20/- in cash between 8 October 2026 and 24 October 2026 during office working hours.
Fill out the application form legibly and correctly with all required details.

Attach self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, age proof, local residency certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), non-creamy layer certificate, and other required documents along with two recent passport-size photographs pasted on the designated spaces with self-signature.
Enclose the application fee via Demand Draft (DD) in favor of "तहसिलदार अंधेरी तथा सदस्य सचिव, कोतवाल निवड समिती".
Write "मुंबई उपनगर जिल्हा कोतवाल भरती-२०२६, तालुका (अंधेरी, बोरीवली व कुर्ला पैकीकी १ नमूद करणे आवश्यक)" clearly in bold letters on the envelope containing the application.

Submit the completed application form along with enclosures either by hand or through registered post to the respective Tehsildar office (Andheri, Borivali, or Kurla) on or before 24 October 2026 up to 6:15 PM.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely on an honorarium and temporary/unclassified basis, and candidates will not receive retirement benefits. Selected candidates must submit a Rs. 100/- bond stating they agree to relocation within the taluka if required. Applications sent to any authority other than the designated Tehsildar offices will be rejected. Candidates must bring original photo identity cards (Aadhaar Card, Election Card, PAN Card, Smart Card Driving License, etc.) to the examination center. Mobile phones, Bluetooth devices, smartwatches, calculators, and electronic gadgets are strictly prohibited inside the examination center. Incomplete applications, forms without fee payment, or applications received after the deadline will be rejected summarily. The total number of vacancies is subject to increase or decrease as per administrative requirements. Selected candidates must submit caste validity certificates within six months of the appointment order date.

content_sections.heading: Kotwal Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 13 vacancies distributed across Tehsildar Andheri, Tehsildar Borivali, and Tehsildar Kurla. The notification warns that the total number of vacancies may increase or decrease. The District Collector may also cancel the recruitment fully or partly, and no dispute can be raised on this.

content_sections.heading: Kotwal Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a local resident of the respective taluka for whose Kotwal post they are applying. The candidate must be capable of discharging Kotwal duties and must possess good moral character and physical fitness.

rows.qualification_required: Minimum 4th pass. Candidate must have good command of the Marathi language.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kotwal
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form from the office of Tehsildar Andheri, Tehsildar Borivali, or Tehsildar Kurla by paying Rs. 20/- in cash between 8 October 2026 and 24 October 2026 during office working hours. Fill out the application form legibly and correctly with all required details. Attach self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, age proof, local residency certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), non-creamy layer certificate, and other required documents along with two recent passport-size photographs pasted on the designated spaces with self-signature. Enclose the application fee via Demand Draft (DD) in favor of "तहसिलदार अंधेरी तथा सदस्य सचिव, कोतवाल निवड समिती". Write "मुंबई उपनगर जिल्हा कोतवाल भरती-२०२६, तालुका (अंधेरी, बोरीवली व कुर्ला पैकीकी १ नमूद करणे आवश्यक)" clearly in bold letters on the envelope containing the application. Submit the completed application form along with enclosures either by hand or through registered post to the respective Tehsildar office (Andheri, Borivali, or Kurla) on or before 24 October 2026 up to 6:15 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: True copy of educational qualification mark sheets/certificates (minimum 4th pass mark sheet/certificate). Proof of age (School Leaving Certificate or Birth Certificate). Proof of local residency of the concerned taluka issued by the Tehsildar. Attested copy of caste certificate (if claiming reserved category) and validity certificate where applicable. Marriage registration certificate or name change affidavit (for married women). Valid Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate for reserved categories. EWS eligibility certificate issued as per Government Resolutions. Two recent passport-size color photographs.

content_sections.heading: Kotwal Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on an honorarium and temporary/unclassified basis, and candidates will not receive retirement benefits. Selected candidates must submit a Rs. 100/- bond stating they agree to relocation within the taluka if required. Applications sent to any authority other than the designated Tehsildar offices will be rejected. Candidates must bring original photo identity cards (Aadhaar Card, Election Card, PAN Card, Smart Card Driving License, etc.) to the examination center. Mobile phones, Bluetooth devices, smartwatches, calculators, and electronic gadgets are strictly prohibited inside the examination center. Incomplete applications, forms without fee payment, or applications received after the deadline will be rejected summarily. The total number of vacancies is subject to increase or decrease as per administrative requirements. Selected candidates must submit caste validity certificates within six months of the appointment order date.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the Kotwal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Mumbai Suburban District administration for Tehsildar offices in Andheri, Borivali, and Kurla.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 13 vacancies are available for the Kotwal post across Andheri (6), Borivali (3), and Kurla (4) talukas.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Kotwal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications offline is 24 October 2026 up to 6:15 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Kotwal post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed at least the 4th standard and possess a good working knowledge of the Marathi language.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 40 years of age as of 24 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How much is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 700/- for Open category candidates and Rs. 500/- for backward class and EWS candidates, excluding the Rs. 20/- form price.

faq.question: Q7. When will the written examination be conducted?
faq.answer: The written examination is scheduled for 15 November 2026 from 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. Is the appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is temporary and on an honorarium basis, and regular retirement benefits do not apply.
